its a smaller site when it comes to people seeing content but overall I have continued to use it as my go to place to share content I come across. A majority involves current events and such and I do not mind if it doesn't recieve any upvotes or comments as my primary focus is to just share content and basically add to my post archive. I have since come to utilizing my posting more as an archive aspect over community involvement. I expect that to change if growth kicks in, but there is just one aspect I just dont seem to get...

Whoaverse doesnt have that many users that can influence what is going on, and has even fewer individuals who have the ability to downvote. It is not a big deal to me and I am no where emotionally affected but thought it was worth sharing that I have come under a lot of downvoting (You are welcome to go look for yourself and see how a lot of my posts are clearly evident to targeted downvoting). And I am okay if the content is not fitting or if it is too extreme, but some posts that are just basic factual aspects that I see little reason to downvote aside from the conscious choice to reject the content for the whole/existence. The only motive I can think of as a possibility is to obscure visibility. I cant say that I care as much, but I also can't picture myself trying to do good and expect it to be downvoted. I have tried many times to speak my mind on implementing ideas that can help diffuse downvote abuse, but its starting to seem more like dust in the wind then having an influence. I even use to go the extra lentgh to create designed infographics and visual elements, but as it showed to be me just putting more work into it then its worth, I have slowly started to give up on pushing that extra effort - but I at least still try to offer ideas and concepts. Even discussing ideas that make a lot of sense and have been giving a lot of thought are either being downvoted or just don't seem to carry influence.

I thought that maybe with whoaverse in its earlier stages that I could help make it the most it could be, but I think if supporting this site's growth through content is only going to backfire and eat away at my moral - its going to just push me away from continuing on. I'd hate to see that happen as I think there is a lot of potential here.

The situation sucks and it all fits into fair game perspective, so I don't mean to offer complaints but its been on my mind and I rather release it somehow than to bottle it up. I think it makes it easier to let go. I know I don't check the stats of my posts unless I have to go back to find a link or if I am curious about a certain issue, so it's not like I try to bring awareness of it to my waking life. But its a shitty feeling seeing that the reason you left reddit is the same aspect that is occurring here.

Like I said, I'm practically 99% over it now that I spoke my mind - but I can't imagine anything really being done (& im pretty optimistic) . But i'll keep on keeping on unless its evident that my actions are more compared to using a bucket on a sinking ship - until then I'll remain hopeful. Its really not best to dwell on it so I have to detach myself from the issue.

Life happens I guess.
